UnicodeBasic/TableLookup.lean:454 lines implementing binary-search lookup tables for all Unicode properties (Bidi_Class, Canonical_Combining_Class, Case_Folding, Decomposition_Mapping, General_Category, Name, Numeric_Value, Script_Extensions, etc.)

UnicodeBasic/Types.lean:742 lines defining formal type structures (GC as bitmask with boolean algebra, NumericType inductive, CompatibilityTag, DecompositionMapping, BidiClass inductive, Script/ScriptSet) with instances and parsers
util/MakeTables.lean:872 lines of IO code generating table data files from UnicodeData — build utility, no library declarations
util/TestTables.lean:172 lines of test predicates comparing generated tables against UnicodeData — test utility, no library declarations

rules.content_invariant: No definitions, theorems, or instances that constitute the library's formal mathematics; only IO-driven table generation and test harness code
evidence: MakeTables.lean: main function writes table files to disk, imports UnicodeData for generation, no public API exports
TestTables.lean: main function runs test predicates against UnicodeData stream, prints errors, returns exit code
rules.rationale: Build-time code generation and test verification utilities; contain no formal mathematical declarations, proofs, or library API surface

summary: Inspected all 5 files in the work unit. The three core library files (UnicodeBasic.lean, UnicodeBasic/TableLookup.lean, UnicodeBasic/Types.lean) contain formal mathematical declarations: Unicode property definitions, type structures (GC, BidiClass, Script, NumericType, etc.), lookup algorithms, and public API functions. These are formal mathematics content relevant to search. The two util/ files are build-time code generation (MakeTables.lean) and test verification (TestTables.lean) utilities — they contain no library declarations/proofs and are not part of the formal mathematics API. Per FILTER-004(1), a prover-aware check confirms they hold no formal mathematical declarations/proofs relevant to the corpus.
